name: Blackrock Caverns: Beauty goes Berserk when the first of her pups dies (#13821)
contract: #13821: Beauty 39700 fights with her pups Lucky 40008, Spot 40011 and Runty 40015. The script cast Berserk
5011079 only when Runty died. In an Ascension combat log from 2026-08-22, Beauty gained Berserk right after
Spot, the first pup, died, while Lucky and Runty were still alive. The player engages Beauty in her room on
Normal, kills Spot, and Beauty must gain Berserk with Lucky and Runty alive. CONTROL: no Berserk before a pup

steps.label: The player joins world phase 1, where the dungeon spawns live
CONTROL: Spot is in the room
CONTROL: Runty is in the room
CONTROL: no Berserk while every pup lives
DISCRIMINATING: Beauty goes Berserk after the first pup dies
